import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))
